In this installment, Dan and Jordan check in to hear Alex discuss grenade-training monkeys, loving Elon Musk, and his feelings about one of his employees getting murdered.

==Tidbits==

* Alex Jones's employee, [[Jamie White]], was murdered
* Alex's instinct is to blame the Austin DA
* But [[Jamie White]] may have been on a Ukrainian hit list. [https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2025/mar/14/alex-jones/infowars-reporter-jamie-white-who-was-fatally-shot/ He wasn't]
* The police have lost one third of cops to job cuts, and another third to social work, brainwashing, and PR, so how can they investigate?
* [[José Garza]] (Austin DA) is an 'admitted communist' and 'literally a racist'
* Thanks to Mel Gibson, we know that the LA fires were all deliberate
* Alex's hypothetical about a monkey with a grenade goes awry. He's bad at metaphors.   
* Alex feels really bad that his colleague was killed, so he needs to blame someone. Choosing between the DA or the Ukrainians, depending on which angle is stronger.
* Alex claims that the left is deliberately destroying society, including hundreds of attacks on Tesla facilities. (Actually, Newsweek says attacks are in the low teens)
* [[George Soros|Soros]] is a mean hombre: "He was rounding up people for death camps when he was a teenager."
* [[Elon Musk|Musk]] keeps on doing what Alex claims [[George Soros|Soros]] is doing, but Alex is just fine with it.
* Alex has been thinking about vigilantism.
* Alex describes his son Rex knocking out a "crazy homeless person."    
* If you live in a city, you need to adopt a "bunker mentality", carry a gun and be prepared to use it.
* Alex falsely accuses [[José Garza]] of malfeasance.
* Trump promotes Tesla, Alex loves it. He'll be raffling a Tesla Cybertruck.
* Maybe, just maybe... the murder of [[Jamie White]] was a botched attempt on Alex's own life?
* Ukrainians tried to kill Trump at Mar-a-Lago.
* Alex professes to be a psychic, but couldn't save Gene Hackman...   
* Alex denies he fetishizes violence, forgetting all the times when he does.
